meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把附加的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档在本地转成 Markdown，并读取和总结其中内容，不再需要上传到外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当代理收到需要阅读的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档附件时触发。

say.text: 把附件里的 Word 转成 Markdown 并总结。
say.note: Claude 会本地转换并读取内容。

say.text: 分析这个 Excel 文件，列出关键数据。
say.note: Claude 转换后按 Markdown 内容回答。

say.text: 这份 PDF 能直接转 Markdown 吗？
say.note: 文本型 PDF 可以；扫描版会提示需要 OCR。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can convert attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and similar office docs to Markdown locally, then read and summarize the content without uploading to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the agent needs to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or similar office documents, including text-based PDFs, without uploading them.

say_en.text: Convert the attached Word file to Markdown and summarize it.
say_en.note: Claude converts locally and reads the content.

say_en.text: Analyze this Excel file and list the key data.
say_en.note: Claude converts it and answers from the Markdown.

say_en.text: Can this PDF be converted directly to Markdown?
say_en.note: Text-based PDFs work; scanned ones need OCR.
